title: Core comparison morphism and termwise annihilation
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-push-pull, the pushforward is coherent and there exist a comparison morphism from G to its completion and an exponent t >= 1 such that the ideal power K^t annihilates the kernels and cokernels of every component.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 088B and Remark 0888

proof.text: Construct the comparison morphism by the theorem on formal functions, glue over affine opens, pass to the adic completion, algebraize the formal system, and use that the adjunction is an isomorphism away from V(K); the support and reduction arguments give one uniform exponent for all component kernels and cokernels.

mathlib_searches.query: proper pushforward formal completion kernel cokernel annihilated by ideal power

mathlib_searches.results: only the target module; no existing theorem

lean.statement: theorem exists_formalSystemsPushPull_core {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] (J K : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (_hV : IsIso (pullback.snd f (Scheme.Opens.ι K.support.compl))) (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X) (_β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ≅ formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj) : ∃ h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj), ∃ α : G ⟶ (completion Y J).obj ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩, ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2 (kernel (α.hom.app (op n)))) ∧ IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2 (cokernel (α.hom.app (op n))))
